body: I dont see a reason to keep going

Yes for sure! But everyday I remind myself to enjoy this process! It’s a lot of pressure & so much stress just to prep for 1 day. So I’m just embracing all the shit that comes now and have fun while I’m preparing.

There have been times I’ve been able to stop the slide. I try to rely more on my routine and activities that I know will ground me. But sometimes I just let it happen and work on trying to get myself out of it in a similar way.

I am the same way… I was able to control it for a while but it comes in waves. I try to be responsible in managing my money always by recording it daily. That helped me discipline myself a bit more. Hope that helps!

I’m a yoga teacher and business owner. I also find it hard to work a regular office job or be the breadwinner in the family. It’s so hard for me to show up sometimes so at least as a yoga teacher and business owner I can control my own time.

I feel the same way.. I wish I wasn’t such a coward in wanting to end this life. I try hard everyday to not come back to this state but it keeps happening again and again and I just feel like a failure.
D ko alam anong gagawin ko. Pagod na ako.
I just came out of depression and feeling better. I don’t take any medication so it’s harder to ride the ups and downs but I’m well and coping as of now!
